notes: member_role is NULL (not absent) when the caller holds no ProjectMember row — scalar subquery with zero rows (views/project.py:123-129,338-344).

sort_order is annotated ONLY on the list GET (views/project.py:169-177); detail/create/update responses carry no sort_order key from the queryset (the read serializer declares the field, so it renders null).
total_members counts non-bot active members only; bots are excluded (views/project.py:103-110).
Public projects (network=2) are listed by any workspace member; private ones only with an active membership (views/project.py:85-91).
Rows are illustrative shapes with synthetic ids; the SQL shapes and NULL semantics are the pinned contract.
